newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Hicom to make trucks with Isuzu.
newsitem.headline: Hicom to make trucks with Isuzu.

text.p: Malaysia's automobile, finance and construction group Hicom Holdings Bhd said on Wednesday it has signed a joint venture agreement to manufacture trucks with Japan's Isuzu Motors Ltd.

It said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange that the joint venture for designing, manufacturing, assembling and marketing the "Malaysian National Trucks" was signed on March 26 this year.
The joint venture company would be called Malaysian Truck & Bus Sdn Bhd (MTB).
Hicom and group associate Diversified Resources Bhd would hold 40 percent equity each in the joint venture, with the remaining 20 percent held by Isuzu.
MTB has an authorised share capital of 100 million shares of one ringgit each. Only 12.5 million shares have been issued, all of them to Hicom, the statement said.
It said the total project is expected to cost 280 million ringgit, to be funded with both equity and bank borrowings.
